subject: hardy

rows.name: Historical true-statement solve outcomes
rows.importance_reason: Informs model selection for a selected problem set.
rows.credit_reason: 165 true-statement attempts across three different model boards; historical provenance only, not a pooled comparative estimate.
rows.formula: Per board: solved true rows / all true rows, with a Wilson interval; no cross-model pooling.

rows.name: Historical false-twin refusal outcomes
rows.importance_reason: Informs whether a model refuses deliberately false statements.
rows.credit_reason: 15 false-twin attempts, five per model; older procedure identity prevents a current-code claim.
rows.formula: Per board: refused false rows / false rows; exhaustion and grading are distinct outcomes.

rows.name: Historical resource usage observations
rows.importance_reason: Informs run budgets and cost estimates.
rows.credit_reason: 177 of 180 rows report cost and all 180 report wall time; observations are historical and heterogeneous by model.
rows.formula: Totals report sums alongside rows_with_cost/rows_with_wall; per-tier medians use solved rows only.

rows.name: Current reviewed headline solve rate
rows.importance_reason: Informs whether the harness solves reviewed statements beyond automation.
rows.credit_reason: Zero active statements among the 20 shipped entries, and no matching local procedure evidence.
rows.formula: Solved active tier-2/3 rows / active tier-2/3 rows; no denominator yields null.

rows.name: Current automation floor
rows.importance_reason: Determines problem tiers and whether model success exceeds the tactic baseline.
rows.credit_reason: The available 1166-entry sweep has a stale procedure digest and describes a broader corpus than main.
rows.formula: Tier determined by current fixed single-tactic and tactic-chain attempts under recorded limits.

rows.name: Causal contribution of the harness
rows.importance_reason: Informs the stated experiment assessing Hardy against the same model without it.
rows.credit_reason: No reported paired control experiment in the inspected evidence.
rows.formula: Paired success and misleading-completion differences between harness and control arms.
rows.unmeasurable_reason: The inspected records provide no same-model paired control arm.

rows.name: Faithfulness reviewer agreement with expert labels
rows.importance_reason: Informs whether the pre-proof translation gate can be trusted to detect drift.
rows.credit_reason: Mechanism and failure handling are tested; reviewer accuracy has no labelled calibration sample in the inspected evidence.
rows.formula: Agreement and false-negative rate against held-out human-labelled request/statement pairs.
rows.unmeasurable_reason: No held-out human-labelled calibration set was found in the inspected corpus and local records.

findings.title: Available outcomes describe older source and corpus identities
findings.detail: Three local boards contain 180 rows in total, each over 60 selected statements. None matches its freshly computed run procedure digest. The local 1166-entry baseline also has an older procedure identity; main ships 20 candidate statements. These records establish historical observations, not performance of this checkout.
findings.blast_radius: Model selection and deciding which statements still need a measured run.

findings.title: The shipped corpus has no reviewed headline denominator
findings.detail: All 20 statements on main are candidates. Corpus curation deliberately lives on a separate branch. A headline is correctly withheld until reviewed statements and matching evidence exist.
findings.blast_radius: Interpreting headline solve rates as mathematical coverage.

findings.title: The harness contribution has not been isolated
findings.detail: README explicitly says the same-model harness-versus-control experiment has not reported. The available model boards do not supply a paired control arm.
findings.blast_radius: Claiming that the harness improves success or prevents misleading completion.

findings.title: Faithfulness review reliability is unmeasured in the inspected evidence
findings.detail: The reviewer sees the original request and frozen statement in a separate context and fails closed. No held-out human-labelled calibration set for this gate was found in the inspected corpus or evaluation records; hermetic tests exercise decisions rather than measuring reviewer accuracy.
findings.blast_radius: Treating an agreeing heuristic reviewer as authority that the theorem matches the request.

not_audited: The corpus/curation branch and external experiment archives were not switched into or inspected.
No paid model, live Lean, downloaded paper, or generated TeX execution was performed for this overview.
This inventory covers evaluation and pre-proof faithfulness decisions; it is not an exhaustive statistical audit of every capability.
